analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and file metadata against the indexed threat model and selected T-041 details. register-model.yml changes only the runner to ubuntu-24.04 and adds a 30-minute timeout (head 95–96). Its coordinator allowlist remains before secret use (101–111), inputs remain environment-bound and jq-encoded, and publication still uses a fixed HTTPS origin without redirect following (219–237). No supported credential-exposure, model-integrity or pricing regression follows from that runner change. release-desktop.yml changes the source and publishing runners (patch head 59, 519), retaining timeouts, permissions and the source/sign-dmg dependency; no evidence establishes a runner-specific security prerequisite being lost.
provider-tests.yml adds a component-bound tree record through scripts/ci-tested-tree.py (head 1514–1521, 1531–1539) and enables artifact overwrite (1529). The visible gate still requires selected lanes and CI-plan checks (1461–1492). Its surrounding .git-cache validation, credential-free checkout, build-cache handling and test execution were examined; these are unchanged in this excerpt and are not reported as new issues. These Actions caches are not the inference prefix cache in T-041, and no prompt encryption, serving authorization or billing code changes are shown.
Integration must reconcile the new tree-record producer with scripts/ci-tested-tree.py and provider-plan.yml: verify successful-run provenance, workflow/event trust, exact tree/component matching, and overwrite handling before prior results suppress builds/tests. That contract is material to artifact integrity (A-011/A-017, T-054), but its consumer implementation is outside this batch, so no bypass finding is established. Earlier provider-tests.yml changes are only partially represented by orientation patches; release-desktop source/signing/publishing bodies are also outside this supplied scope.
